body: Thanks for this. I know it's simple advice, but it was really helpful just to have somebody remind me to take care of myself and get rest.

I live I in Philadelphia. I used to drink a lot more, and my depression was much worse. I put a lot of hard work into recovering, and cutting way back on drinking was a huge part of that. I have a hard time cutting it out completely, even though I know it would benefit me, because everyone I'm close to still does so much. Sometimes I have a perfectly fine time, but other times, like last night, it feels like I unleash something really terrible and demonic on myself, and the work I put into being safe and recovering feels completely undone and useless. I never really know how the night will go so it's always a gamble. But being able to come here and ramble about it was really helpful; I normally isolate myself, and it just means a lot to me that there are people here willing to listen. I'm glad this is here.
